constraints.description: Record about the same length as the source segment
Play at the source tempo (counted beats per minute)
Audio upload, at least 3 s, no clipping; video optional and not scored

instructions:
1. Listen to the source segment (20.0-32.0 s of the recording, 12 s) several times. Its stroke pulse is 0.189 s, about 158 beats per minute counting 2 strokes per beat [CLM-01].
2. Record yourself playing about the same length (12 s) at the source tempo, placing every stroke on the pulse as the source does [CLM-02].
3. Sound the bass (bayan) on the same strokes as the source and withhold it elsewhere: BBB--.B---B- repeating every 12 pulses [CLM-04] [CLM-03].
4. Keep the pulse steady from the first stroke to the last; do not speed up or slow down [CLM-05].
5. Record in a quiet room with the phone about 1 m from the drums and check the recording is not distorted. Upload audio (any common format); a video may be attached but is not scored [CLM-06].
title: Play the source tabla segment at its tempo with the same bass pattern
